source.data_source: DefiLlama fetchProtocolHistory (suppliedByAssetQty per asset, per day) for protocol slug 'aave-v3'
source.methodology: Per-asset delta on day D = (qty_D − qty_{D-1}) × latest_observed_price. Constant-price flow methodology — isolates real deposit/withdraw activity from collateral price drift. Same data path as scripts/query-aave-may-daily-flows.ts and the dashboard's Sankey aggregator (lib/net-flows-sankey.ts).
source.caveat: USD figures use the LATEST observed price per asset, not the price on the target day. Cross-citing against the dashboard's price-current TVL is not valid — only the net-change figures are.
source.note: No single asset is the #1 outflow on more than 1 of the 3 target days. The three big outflow days were each driven by a different asset; the post-May-14 outflow story on Aave V3 is not one-asset-led.
